plugins.name: superskillret
plugins.description: Embedding-based skill retrieval. On every user prompt, picks the top-K relevant skills from a 16,783-skill pool (ThakiCloud/SKILLRET) and injects them as context, using the ThakiCloud/SkillRet-Embedding-0.6B encoder behind a long-running local daemon. v0.2.5: per-session dedup default OFF (was on); set SUPERSKILLRET_SEEN_TRACKING=1 to opt back in. v0.2.4 daemon lazy-spawn from CLI. v0.2.3 empty-args fix. v0.2.2 PLUGIN_ROOT + bare-name + skip-dup. v0.2.1 lazy install. v0.2.0 custom skill registration.
